what: Across the whole panel, 9px fixed-width alphanumerics are laid in every cell, and only the bright 35% of a diagonally flowing three-layer value-noise pattern is stamped, with a max opacity of .3. It flows at 30 frames per second and 1% of the characters change every frame, so it shimmers. Within a 100px mouse radius it brightens up to 1.2×, and passed spots leave a tail with a 150px radius that fades out over 3 seconds. Used on dark footer and stage backgrounds.

options.density: Ratio of cells that light up, side value, default .35 (actual ratio is × .7)
options.chars: Characters to write, default English upper/lowercase letters + digits
options.color: CSS color of the panel — default --kf-contrast-ink. Typeface is --kf-font-mono

note: Text and links inside the panel are position: relative; Place it above the canvas with z-index: 1. Pauses when offscreen or in a hidden tab, and draws a single frame under reduced motion

from.where: Footer background on every page — the original Framer code component (charset alphanumeric · Geist Mono 9px · letter-spacing 1px · line-height 1.2em · density .35 · opacity .3 · patchSize 160 · speed .1 · layers 3 · seed 2 · hoverRadius 100 · hoverStrength .2 · trail 3 · trailSize 150 · trailOpacity .6 · 33ms frame)
